messages.content: Separate paragraphs with a visible divider line. Separate paragraphs using this exact line on its own: "=====". The first line of your response must be exactly: "Today, I want to start with a simple question.". Do not use more than 6 paragraphs. (Separate paragraphs clearly.) No digits are allowed anywhere in the response.

Create a startup pitch for a new startup that will help people to find the best places to live. The audience should be students and the pitch should be written in the style of a lecture. Put a clear separator line between paragraphs. Every divider line must be exactly: "*****". Start your response with this exact line: "Good afternoon everyone.". Write 7 paragraphs or more. (Make paragraph breaks clear.) Do not use digits (0–9).
